messages.content: Extract compact predicate structure from the exact source unit. This is syntax/semantic-role acquisition, not a permission/prohibition/obligation classifier. Do not supply normative effect labels or answer a legal question. Include each predicate governing disclosure, return/destruction or retention and each such conduct predicate, including an embedded condition, lexical governor, exception, coordination and source references. predicate_quote is the exact lexical head word, excluding auxiliaries and negation. modal_quote is the exact modal auxiliary word such as shall or may, or empty if absent. negation_quote is an exact local negation cue, or empty; it belongs to the predicate actually negated, not automatically every embedded conduct. actor_quote/object_quote identify the actual role arguments as exact SOURCE substrings. Include information ownership and original copy quantifiers when stated. Do not invent an antecedent; unresolved roles are empty. All nonempty quotes must occur literally in this unit. Edges go from governing predicate to child. A condition is not a complement. For an archival exception the main obligation predicate is parent and retention is the exception child. Relation quote preserves the whole relevant qualifying clause including its marker, not just if/except. A reference such as exceptions provided elsewhere is reference, not a new permission. Do not create alternative false parses to populate a quota. Use unique local node IDs and omit nonexistent edges. Return only the schema object with nodes and edges. No native queries, answers or source feedback are supplied. The user gives complete same-section source context and a focus_quote. Extract predicates in the focus and their governing predicates. Preserve the remaining actual qualifications as source relation quotes without converting every contextual mention into another focus conduct. One node per actual predicate occurrence. predicate_quote must select one lexical word from the schema source vocabulary; never repeat auxiliary/negation in that field. Keep the actual if/when/except distinctions.

{"source_context": "3. Exemptions to Non-Disclosure. Notwithstanding Sections 1 and 2, a Participating Entity shall not have breached any obligation under this Agreement if the Confidential Information is disclosed to a third party when the Confidential Information:
(a) was in the public domain at the time of such disclosure or is subsequently made available to the public by the Participating Entity who provided the Confidential Information, or otherwise consistent with the terms of this Agreement; or
(b) had been received or independently developed by such Participating Entity at or prior to the time of disclosure through a process other than the development or implementation of the Cyber Mutual Assistance Program; or
(c) is subsequently disclosed to the Participating Entity by a third party without restriction on use and without breach of any agreement or legal duty; or
(d) subject to the provisions of Section 4, is used or disclosed pursuant to statutory duty, such as a public records act request, or an order, subpoena, discovery request, or other lawful process issued by a court or other governmental authority of competent jurisdiction or in a judicial proceeding; or
(e) is disclosed by unanimous agreement of each of the Participating Entity or Participating Entities whose information is subject to such disclosure; or
(f) after the time of its disclosure hereunder, becomes subsequently available to such Participating Entity on a non-confidential basis from a source not known by such Participating Entity to be bound by a confidentiality agreement or secrecy obligation in respect thereof.", "focus_quote": "3.
